purpose: Create source-only cute V9 Daily-left reflections that remain clearly image-left after fixed V9 eye-body normalization.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the only generator reference. V36 attempt-01 remains comparison evidence and is not a prompt input.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 Daily-left source face
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on plain white; no grey, color, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the enclosed large glossy oval and small four-point companion sparkle inside each existing open black eye silhouette
output_contract.rig_legibility: after normalization into fixed V9 eye bodies, both dominant reflections are at least 3 px image-left from exact V9 Daily rest; both sparkles travel with their primary and all white marks retain a continuous black rim
protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
large pupil-like white disc, detached sparkle, cross-eye placement or extra charm
new face, brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
full-face runtime frame or animation loop
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, activation, provisioning or firmware flash
